GTA 6 Pre-Orders Begin, Pricing and Editions Announced

Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) are set to begin on June 25, with the game scheduled for release on November 19, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. The game will be available in a Standard Edition priced at $79.99 and a digital-only Ultimate Edition at $99.99. Physical copies of the game will not include a disc but rather a code for a digital download. All pre-orders will receive the Vintage Vice City Pack, and a PC version has not been confirmed for the initial launch.
